title: Lemma 1.2: countable rectifiability via C¹ submanifold covers
statement: For all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ}: M is countably n-rectifiable (M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃ⱼ Fⱼ(ℝⁿ) with Hⁿ(M₀) = 0 and Fⱼ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} Lipschitz) if and only if there are N₀ ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with Hⁿ(N₀) = 0 and sets N_j (j ∈ ℕ), each an n-dimensional embedded C¹ submanifold in the sense of IsC1Submanifold n (Simon Ch. 2 (4.1): local injective C¹ parametrizations ψ : V → W with ψ(V) = W ∩ N_j, relatively proper, with injective derivative), such that M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_j N_j.
